# Elspeth Young

**Elspeth Young** was the wife of John Telfer of Castleton, Roxburghshire, and mother of James Telfer (1761–1845).

## Vital Details

- **Born:** ~1725–1740 (estimated — exact date unknown)
- **Maiden name:** Young
- **Spouse:** John Telfer (of Castleton) (m. unknown, ~1750s)
- **Died:** Unknown

## Known Children

| Child | Born/Baptised | Notes |
|-------|--------------|-------|
| **James Telfer (1761–1845)** | Baptised 14 Jul 1761, Castleton | Named as son of John Telfer & **Elspeth Young** in Castleton OPR. |

> **Note:** Elspeth Young is known only from the baptism record of her son James. The Castleton OPR does not record her death, and her Young family connections are unknown.

## ⚠️ Research Gaps

- No birth, marriage, or death records found
- Young family origins unknown — may come from a nearby Roxburghshire parish
- Full name may be Elizabeth (Elspeth is a Scots diminutive of Elizabeth)
